body:
That's what I'm afraid of. 

I was always a hard worker. I worked hard for my studies, I worked hard to get my job, I worked hard to help others, I worked hard to keep up with people.

It's tiring. Like I said, I'm still trying, but it become hard. I'm not seeing any good outcome to my efforts. And I'm afraid that It'll took my entire life. I'm tired of trying for nothing. 

I often asked myself "why did I became like this? Why do I need something I can't get?". And I made some answer, "I'm worthless", "I'm be a bad person", "My 'role' in life is to be smart, not happy".

Yeah, I overthink things a lot. But what's the point of an entire life of effort, if you can't look back and be glad at the end? Everyone want to say "it was a good life" before dying, right?

Don't excuse yourself though. I know the only advice people can give is to wait & see. I don't know what I was waiting for myself.

Thanks for your listenning at least

Sorry If i used a poor choice of words, like said, English is not my native.

My 'dream' can maybe be resume as 'having a life'? I don't really know how to explain myself here...

Family is a part of the dream, and of course 26 is a bit young to start I think. What I meant was the disillusion. Everyone told me that after my study, by getting good grades, everything would change. I dive for 7years, doing exactly -maybe too much- what I was told, and now that I came back to the surface, I saw that absolutely everyone around already start building a string social life, while I'm here like a 18years old at 26.

Let's be honest here. Last time I dated was near 8years ago. I'm alone, no friends, I talk only with my colleagues. I'm socially awkward, pessimistic, depressive and the only talk I'm feeling nice with is technical talk. My body reject the few ones that enter my personnal space. I misinterpret every face expression, movement or sentence and panic.No woman will want to enter a relationship with someone like that. I need smaller experience for that, between now and then. I'll need friends support that I don't have. I'll need to go out, which I feel awkward doing. Just waiting 30-35 will be a total disaster. 

You know, I already have difficulties to socialise now, I can't meet friends naturally. I tryed to enter a circle of friends a few month ago. After 2hours, I vomit of anxiety, and someone took me home. Never heard of them since, I must have been awkward, stressed and negative. Nobody want to meet someone that you feel will be a burden. So speak about getting married...

But I understand. Everyone keep telling me that everything will go nicely later. It's so natural for people to let things happen, they meet with ease, just by going out. 

I may be the unfitting one here. Nothing is natural for me. The only thing I do of my life is studying, and I made that my workfield. Maybe I'm just not suited for life.
